native_retained_resources.identity: Exact scope, kind and bounded draft ID; find_checkpoint resolves one exact Expression reference within the requested scope and refuses ambiguity.
native_retained_resources.write_law: Native compare-and-swap: null expected_revision creates an absent record; existing writes and removals require the exact current revision. Native monotonic revisions survive remove/recreate. Atomic private-file writes and native file locking; failures preserve existing recovery bytes.

bounds.eviction: none; refuse excess without deleting retained work

native_retained_resources.authority: Private local working material and interrupted-operation checkpoints only. No canonical Central file, source/publication authority, automatic replay or permission grant. Reopen and mutation still use the ordinary native Expression owner with its exact basis.
native_retained_resources.spec_ref: docs/cradle/02-ARCHITECTURE.md §5–6/§12; canonical desktop-agent-conformance-rectification-2026-09-23-1756.md Lane A–B; 2026-09-24 commissioned native Expression restart recovery
native_retained_resources.rationale: Hosted macOS WebKit third-party IndexedDB does not reliably survive app restart; native private storage retains the working draft independently of the canonical document.
